# Canonical imports

```tsx
import type { AnnotationInput } from 'annota';
import { useTool } from 'annota/react';
import { PointTool } from 'annota/tools';
import { loadH5Masks } from 'annota/loaders';
import 'annota/styles.css';
```

The old `annota/dist/index.css` path can still be described in prose.

## Historical migration example

```tsx annota-legacy-imports
import { useTool, PointTool } from 'annota';
import 'annota/dist/index.css';
```

## Current equivalent

```tsx
import { useTool } from 'annota/react';
import { PointTool } from 'annota/tools';
import 'annota/styles.css';
```
